title: Mission: Honey Bee
subtitle: Help the hive by learning honey bees.
summary: Meet the honey bee, learn its body parts, and carry pollen from flower to flower.
activityInstruction: Move the bee to the flower, collect pollen, then bring it back to the hive.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do bees collect from flowers?
storyQuestions.success: Bees collect pollen and nectar from flowers.
Bees live together in a hive.

storyQuestions.prompt: What do bees make from nectar?

storyQuestions.success: Bees carry pollen that helps flowers grow.

quiz.prompt: Which bee part helps it smell flowers?
What do bees use to collect nectar?
quiz.success: Bees use their proboscis to sip nectar.

quiz.prompt: What does a bee carry on its legs?
quiz.success: Pollen baskets on the legs carry pollen.

quiz.prompt: Why do bees fly between flowers?

parts.label: Antennae
parts.fact: Antennae help bees smell flowers and sense the world.
parts.help: The feelers on the bee's head.

parts.label: Wings
parts.fact: A bee flaps its wings very fast to fly from flower to flower.
parts.help: The see-through wings on the back.

parts.label: Body
parts.fact: The bee's body is striped with yellow and black bands.

parts.label: Proboscis
parts.fact: The proboscis is a tube the bee uses to sip nectar.
parts.help: The tube under the bee's head.

parts.label: Pollen Basket
parts.fact: Pollen baskets on the legs carry pollen back to the hive.
parts.help: The fluffy ball on the back legs.
